definition.en: This topic covers the recent structural, policy, and technological shifts transforming the Indian economic landscape within the framework of GS-3.
definition.hi: This topic covers the recent structural, policy, and technological shifts transforming the Indian economic landscape within the framework of GS-3.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding these developments is crucial for GS-3 as they form the basis for questions on economic growth, policy reforms, and sectoral performance. It helps candidates analyze the impact of government initiatives and regulatory changes on the broader Indian economy.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding these developments is crucial for GS-3 as they form the basis for questions on economic growth, policy reforms, and sectoral performance. It helps candidates analyze the impact of government initiatives and regulatory changes on the broader Indian economy.
